throughput_requirements: Primary ask: sustained minimum 40,000 tokens/sec across the dedicated pool for a 2-hour peak window. Concurrency target: support 200 concurrent generation streams (avg 1k tokens/session). Burst policy requested: tiered bursts - up to 2x sustained for 5 minutes without penalty, emergency burst up to 10x sustained but subject to pre-negotiated burst credits and short-term throttling. Require ability to set per-route concurrency caps and token quotas. Want token accounting aligned with billing windows and transparent telemetry for verification.
sla_discussion: Desired SLOs: p95 generation latency <= 120ms for 32-token responses; p99 <= 400ms. Measurement windows: 1-hour rolling for credits, monthly aggregated reports. Wants automatic fallback to smaller model variant when sustained demand > guaranteed capacity (no hard failures). Credits: proportional to under-delivery vs guaranteed tokens/sec on measurement window. Also requested clear definitions for 'sustained' vs 'burst' and for how prewarming/KV cache warm-up affects first-minute metrics.
poc_plan: 2-week Dedicated POC: reserve 8x high-memory GPU equivalents (A100-class) in VPC. Workload: synthetic replay of 1M sessions/day (mixed gen + rerank) and a 48-hour stress window to validate sustained tokens/sec. Success metrics: maintain min 40k tokens/sec for 2-hour peaks, p95 latency targets, cost per 1M tokens within forecasted band. Milestones: (1) infra config & routing policy, (2) KV cache priming + prefix caching validation, (3) stress run + telemetry handoff, (4) post-POC report with suggested batching/quantization profile from Redwood Optimize. SE to run two validation runs and share trace-level logs for third-party validation.
commercial_notes: Customer prefers committed reserved capacity with a 12-month term; open to tiered commit to cover baseline and burst credits for seasonal peaks. Wants pricing tied to effective tokens/sec guarantee and a clear overage/burst credit policy. Procurement requested sample invoice and amendment language for SLA credits.
